title: Reclassification note (not a new finding): a fresh instance of the already-adjudicated, blocked_tier4 R15-LEAD-030 class ('local model narrates a fabricated tool-result figure') recurs on the current candidate in a NEW surface shape after the tool_call_rescue.py fix closed the specific leaked-text shape this drive's prior attempt (rc1-drive-onboarding-stranger sha 4097dac) had hit
repro: Clean keyless profile, candidate 4c6dfe8c, own sidecar :52326. python3 scripts/r15/vy.py invoke copilot "hi, I just installed this. what can you do, and how is Zomato stock doing today?" --port 52326 --provider ollama --model llama3.1:8b -> two real tool_use/tool_result events (get_terminal_state, ok:true; a UI-state snapshot tool with no price fields in its schema, per sidecar/services/agent_tools/catalog.py:1155-1166), then the assistant TEXT states 'the current price of Zomato (ZOMATO.NS) is ₹130.05 INR. The daily high was ₹132.50, and the daily low was ₹128.60... 2.35% increase' attributed to 'my research'/'the current chart' - no tool result carries any such figures (the default chart symbol SPY quotes $771.35 via /quotes/SPY, nothing resembling these numbers). This is the same defect_class ('hallucinated-tool-result-citation') as the register's R15-LEAD-030, already blocked_tier4 and operator-adjudicated at DECISIONS 4.9 in this gate round; the LEAD NOTE for this round says a new instance of this exact class ('the local model states a figure for a subject with no ok tool call behind it') goes to a register note under the existing entry, never a fresh fix round. Filed as a note, not a new open finding.
